text: The highly open Irish economy has remained resilient in the face of consecutive external shocks, serving as an attractive hub for multinational enterprises (MNEs). Figure 1 outlines Governance Indicators in 2024 (Score in units of a standard normal distribution), Population with Tertiary Education in 2024 (Percent), Old Age Depency Ratio (Percent, population 65+ over population 15-64), and Capital Stock Per Capita (Thousand euro per capita, 2015 prices). Reliance on FDI and tax revenue from a handful of MNEs presents significant risks, and policy actions today shape long-run resilience.
